mapper.sql: id, device_code, name, product_id, protocol, state, enabled, allow_simulate, allow_work, configuration::text as configuration, session_id, last_seen, online_at, registry_time, remark, created_at, updated_at

d.id, d.device_code, d.name, d.product_id, d.protocol, d.state, d.enabled, d.allow_simulate, d.allow_work, d.configuration::text as configuration, d.session_id, d.last_seen, d.online_at, d.registry_time, d.remark, d.created_at, d.updated_at

where.if: and ( lower(d.name) like lower(concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) or d.device_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: select from pep_domain.device_instance d join pep_domain.device_channel c on c.device_id = d.id where c.platform_gun_no = #{platformGunNo}
select from pep_domain.device_instance order by id
select from pep_domain.device_instance where product_id = #{productId} order by id
select count(*) from pep_domain.device_instance where product_id = #{productId}

select concat( (select count(*) from pep_domain.device_protocol_mapping), ':', coalesce((select max(updated_at)::text from pep_domain.device_protocol_mapping), ''), ':', (select count(*) from pep_domain.device_instance), ':', coalesce((select max(updated_at)::text from pep_domain.device_instance), ''), ':', (select count(*) from pep_domain.device_channel), ':', coalesce((select max(updated_at)::text from pep_domain.device_channel), '') )
mapper.update: update pep_domain.device_instance set state = 'OFFLINE', session_id = null, updated_at = #{now} where session_id = 'gateway-telemetry' and state in ('ONLINE', 'FAULT') and last_seen < #{cutoff}
mapper.insert: insert into pep_domain.device_instance (device_code, name, product_id, protocol, state, enabled, allow_simulate, allow_work, configuration, session_id, last_seen, online_at, registry_time, remark, created_at, updated_at) values (#{deviceCode}, #{name}, #{productId}, #{protocol}, #{state}, #{enabled}, #{allowSimulate}, #{allowWork}, cast(#{configuration} as jsonb), #{sessionId}, #{lastSeen}, #{onlineAt}, #{registryTime}, #{remark}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: update pep_domain.device_instance set name = #{name}, state = #{state}, enabled = #{enabled}, allow_simulate = #{allowSimulate}, allow_work = #{allowWork}, configuration = cast(#{configuration} as jsonb), session_id = #{sessionId}, last_seen = #{lastSeen}, online_at = #{onlineAt}, registry_time = #{registryTime}, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select exists (select 1 from pep_domain.charge_order where device_id = #{id}) or exists (select 1 from pep_domain.bill where device_id = #{id}) or exists (select 1 from pep_domain.device_property_ts where device_id = #{id}) or exists (select 1 from pep_domain.device_event_log where device_id = #{id}) or exists (select 1 from pep_domain.command_record where device_id = #{id}) or exists (select 1 from pep_domain.frame_log where device_id = #{id}) or exists (select 1 from pep_domain.trouble_case where device_id = #{id})
